title: 5Axis Machine Cutting HELMET /  DAISHIN SEIKI CORPORATION
summary: A short promotional video of a 5-axis CNC machine milling an elaborate helmet, made by DAISHIN SEIKI with a DMG machine and hyperMILL CAM software. It shows what 5-axis machining can produce.
why: HN uses it as a go-to example of impressive 5-axis machining and CAM-controlled toolpaths.

quote.text: Each year they do some insanely elaborate piece of art in metal as a CNC machining demo.
